body:
"\"Hank\"" <hank@hankville.com> wrote:

>John Preston wrote:

>> =============================================================
>> "The system needs scientists, mathematicians and engineers.
>>  It can't function without them. So heavy pressure is put on
>>  children to excel in these fields."                   -- FC
>> =============================================================

>An interesting choice of tag line.  "So heavy pressure is put on children to 
>excel in these fields."  This is not society's fault - this is his parents' 
>fault.  This is another example of the Unabomber blaming society for his own 
>personal problems.

I would not trace this pressure to either parents or society
exclusively, but to both.  No act can be done without a motive.  No
one is responsible for their motives, but only for their actions.  To
explain how one's motives were affected by others is different from
blaming others for one's actions.  Cynicism results from not seeing
this distinction.
